title: SvgFeFlood
responsibility: Renders the native feFlood element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeFlood.attributes
inputs.description: Native feFlood attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeFlood.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feFlood element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeFlood
outputs.description: The actual native feFlood element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
